title: 第17章 抢肉第18章 熊大熊二
content_zh:
熊主任大手一挥，嚷嚷道：“都别吵吵了！都是自家人，有啥事儿不能商量的！小朱，你快去把你们主任叫来，就你们几个人，能要多少肉啊？我们采购的分你们点儿就得了！”
朱霸杰气鼓鼓地摔门而去！熊主任则满脸堆笑“小同志，来这边坐。大嫂，你去把我办公室的茶叶拿来，给小同志泡杯茶水……”
张昊宇疑惑地问：“你们不应该缺肉吧，两头野猪这么快就吃完了？”熊主任叹了口气“唉，大部分都被上头拉走了！我们根本没剩多少！对了，小同志，这次有多少肉啊？最好能搞点鱼来！上次的鱼也被上头拉走了！”
张昊宇很是惊讶“你们怎么知道我有肉！我也没说我有肉啊？”熊主任愣了一下，看看泡茶的大娘，又看看张昊宇，一时语塞！
大娘笑了笑“我猜的！”张昊宇也笑了，“大娘，你真厉害！还真被你猜对了！而且还挺多的呢！熊主任，你们能要多少啊？”
这次猎人几十人联合围猎野猪群，收获颇丰，不过损失也不小，好几个人都受伤了！好在没有人死亡！
熊主任眼睛一亮“有多少我们都要！价格比上次涨两毛钱，你看行不？”张昊宇给熊主任和厨师每人递了一支中华烟，自己也点上一支。
还没等他开口，一个穿着中山装的中年人，四十几岁的模样，风风火火地推开门走了进来！一进屋就嚷嚷：“熊老二，你敢欺负我们供销社的人？”
熊主任也不甘示弱，“唐三木，你们的人跑到我们国营饭店来抢肉？你们一没有食堂，二不销售肉食，供销社采购肉干啥？”
中年人看着张昊宇，“这位小同志就是小朱说的小宇吧？”张昊宇点点头，“我是张昊宇！”中年人自我介绍道：“我是对面供销社主任唐森！”张昊宇礼貌打招呼“唐主任，你好！”
唐主任笑眯眯点头“我也叫你小宇，你叫我唐大爷咋样，叫什么主任，你又不是供销社的人！”张昊宇微笑着“唐大爷！”唐主任哈哈一笑：“这就对了！”
“小宇啊！你有野味，分点给我们供销社，大爷我肯定不会让你吃亏的，前面的事我也听说了！对错就不多说了！你想换啥物品，只要不是大件的，大爷我尽量帮你想办法搞票，你看行不？”“唐大爷，你们供销社就几个人，能要多少肉啊？”
唐主任一听肉，忙问：“有肉？”张昊宇点头“有野猪、狼、野兔、野鸡！你看想要啥？能要多少？”要野猪肉，五十斤就行！”熊主任开口“唐三木，你们供销社就几个人，要五十斤？每人十几斤，太多了吧？”
“熊主任，这次的野猪有四头呢，两头两百斤以上的，两头三百斤以上的，你吃得下不？”
“吃得下，吃得下！”
“行，四头野猪都给你，唐大爷，我再另外给你五十斤野猪肉，你们二位觉得咋样？”
两个人都点头“好，好！”
“那就这样，把三轮车借我，我去把野猪拉过来。”张昊宇骑着三轮车转了一圈，找了个没人的巷子，钻进空间，把仓库里的野猪用枪打死四头，又把自己烧菜剩下的野猪肉，割了五十斤偏肥的肉。
回到国营饭店后院，大家看到野猪都高兴得合不拢嘴！大家开始称重！朱霸杰和沙武进抬着五十斤偏肥肉，开开心心地回供销社分肉去了！
“小宇，你一会去供销社，我先回去了！”好的，唐大爷。国营饭店的人开始称重，最大的一头野猪407斤，四头野猪一共1239.8斤！

熊主任和张昊宇回到屋里算账，张昊宇好奇地问熊主任：“你们饭店的大蒜头、毛葱头，还有其他带根的葱，以及新鲜的生姜，能不能给我换一点呀？每样半斤一斤就好！再少点也行！”
熊主任大手一挥，“换啥换呀，等会儿给你拿点就是了！这些都是饭店必须要用的调味品！”
熊主任接着说：“按1240斤，2块7一斤算，一共3348元！”张昊宇把钱和证明塞进书包，实际是放进空间仓库里。
熊主任找了些新鲜生姜，有半斤左右，还有四颗大蒜头，八颗小毛葱头，两根大葱，六根小香葱，四五根香菜。
“存货不多！你先拿回去用着，明天货送来了再给你拿一些！”张昊宇连忙说：“熊主任，够啦，够啦！”
张昊宇把东西装进书包，出了国营饭店。他用意念把东西种到地里，还浇了灵泉水！来到供销社，这个时间买东西的人不多，稀稀拉拉的没几个。
供销社的人今天特别开心，应该是已经分完肉了。看到张昊宇进来，大家都热情地跟他打招呼！
张昊宇也微笑着一一回应。“小宇！来，跟我到办公室喝杯茶水。”张昊宇跟着唐主任来到供销社办公室，唐主任热情地“小宇，你坐，我给你泡茶！”
两人坐下后，张昊宇拿出一包中华烟，给唐主任发了一支，自己也点上了一支。“小宇，野猪肉给你按3块一斤，你想换点啥？”
张昊宇想了想，“我要两个手电筒，再配点电池！其他的嘛，就要中华烟、茅台酒、二锅头，高度散装二锅头也行！”
唐主任说：“手电筒和电池都没问题，中华烟和茅台酒没多少了，不过散装二锅头仓库里有几百斤呢！小宇，你先休息一会儿，我去拿东西。”
没一会儿，唐主任就乐颠颠地拿着两把手电筒和一个盒子进了办公室，“小宇，两把手电筒，12节电池，中华烟没了，每次就来两条，还被人一下买走了！”
“茅台酒倒是还有6瓶，这样，给你一百五十斤散装二锅头，6瓶茅台，再加上手电筒和电池，你看行不？”
“行啊，唐大爷！那咱们去拿酒吧！我用三轮车给猎人们送过去，他们还等着呢！”
出了办公室，唐主任喊：“小朱，你把那几瓶茅台酒装三轮车上，再把三轮车推到后院仓库门口，装一百五十斤散装二锅头！”
唐主任又叫上小沙一起过去帮忙。张昊宇和唐也一起去了仓库，张昊宇看到两个青花瓷水缸，唐主任问：“小宇，你喜欢那两个缸吗？”
“嗯！看着真好看！”那就把那两个缸给你吧，正好装两百斤酒！不过那两个缸给你了，就只能给你4瓶茅台咯！”
“行，唐大爷，就要那两缸！”几个人一起把两个缸酒抬到三轮车上，朱霸杰和沙武进用绳子把酒缸绑好。
张昊宇推着三轮车离开供销社，找了个巷子把两缸酒和4瓶茅台收进空间仓库。他又转了一圈回到供销社，手里拿着一只野鸡和一只野兔。
张昊宇把野鸡和野兔递给唐主任，“唐大爷，这野鸡野兔送给你，拿回去尝尝鲜！”唐主任接过野鸡，笑了笑“那我就不客气了！”

content_en:
Director Xiong waved his hand and shouted: "Stop arguing! We are all members of our family, and we can't discuss anything! Xiao Zhu, go and call your director here. How much meat can you just ask for? You can share what we purchase!"
Zhu Bajie slammed the door angrily and left! Director Xiong had a smile on his face, "Comrade, come and sit here. Sister-in-law, go get the tea from my office and make a cup of tea for me..."
Zhang Haoyu asked doubtfully: "You shouldn't be short of meat, right? The two wild boars have been eaten so quickly?" Director Xiong sighed, "Oh, most of them were taken away by the superiors! We don't have much left at all! By the way, little comrade, how much meat is there this time? It's best to get some fish! The fish from last time were also taken away by the superiors!"
Zhang Haoyu was very surprised, "How do you know I have meat! I didn't say I had meat?" Director Xiong was stunned for a moment, looked at the lady making tea, and then looked at Zhang Haoyu, speechless for a moment!
The aunt smiled, "I guessed it!" Zhang Haoyu also smiled, "Auntie, you are so awesome! You really guessed it right! And there are quite a lot of them! Director Xiong, how many can you ask for?"
This time, dozens of hunters joined forces to hunt the wild boar herd, and the harvest was quite fruitful. However, the losses were not small, and several people were injured! Fortunately no one died!
Director Xiong's eyes lit up, "We want as many as we can! The price is 20 cents higher than last time, do you think that's okay?" Zhang Haoyu handed Director Xiong and the chef each a Chinese cigarette, and lit one himself.
Before he could speak, a middle-aged man in Mao suit, in his forties, opened the door and walked in! As soon as he entered the house, he shouted: "Xiong Laoer, do you dare to bully the people in our supply and marketing cooperative?"
Director Xiong was not to be outdone, "Tang Sanmu, your people came to our state-owned hotel to steal meat? You don't have a canteen, and you don't sell meat. Why do the supply and marketing cooperatives buy meat?"
The middle-aged man looked at Zhang Haoyu, "Is this little comrade the Xiaoyu that Xiao Zhu mentioned?" Zhang Haoyu nodded, "I am Zhang Haoyu!" The middle-aged man introduced himself: "I am Tang Sen, director of the supply and marketing cooperative opposite!" Zhang Haoyu greeted politely, "Hello, Director Tang!"
Director Tang smiled and nodded, "I also call you Xiaoyu. Why don't you call me Uncle Tang? What do you call me Director? You are not from the supply and marketing cooperative!" Zhang Haoyu smiled, "Uncle Tang!" Director Tang laughed: "That's right!"
"Xiaoyu! If you have game, give it to our supply and marketing cooperative. I'm sure I won't let you suffer. I've heard what happened before! I won't say more about right or wrong! Whatever items you want to exchange, as long as they are not big items, I will try my best to help you find a way to get tickets. Do you think it will work?" "Uncle Tang, you only have a few people in your supply and marketing cooperative. How much meat can you ask for?"
When Director Tang heard about the meat, he hurriedly asked: "Is there meat?" Zhang Haoyu nodded, "There are wild boars, wolves, hares, and pheasants! What do you want? How much can you want?" If you want wild boar, fifty pounds will be enough! Director Xiong said, "Tang Sanmu, there are only a few people in your supply and marketing cooperative, and you want fifty pounds?" A dozen pounds per person is too much, right? "
"Director Xiong, there are four wild boars this time. Two weigh more than 200 kilograms, and two weigh more than 300 kilograms. Can you eat them? "
“You can eat it, you can eat it! "
"Okay, I'll give you four wild boars, Uncle Tang, and I'll give you another fifty kilograms of wild boar. What do you two think?" "
Both people nodded "Okay, okay!" "
“That’s it, lend me the tricycle and I’ll go pull the wild boar over. "Zhang Haoyu rode a tricycle around, found an empty alley, got into the space, shot four wild boars in the warehouse to death, and cut fifty kilograms of fatter meat from the wild boar meat left over from his own cooking.
Back in the backyard of the state-owned hotel, everyone was so happy to see the wild boar that they opened their mouths from ear to ear! Everyone starts weighing in! Carrying fifty pounds of fat meat, Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujin happily returned to the supply and marketing cooperative to distribute the meat!
"Xiaoyu, you go to the supply and marketing cooperative later, IGo back first! "Okay, Uncle Tang. The people at the state-owned hotel started weighing. The largest wild boar weighed 407 kilograms, and the four wild boars totaled 1,239.8 kilograms!"
Director Xiong and Zhang Haoyu returned to the house to settle accounts. Zhang Haoyu curiously asked Director Xiong: "Can you exchange some of the garlic, shallots, other green onions with roots, and fresh ginger in your hotel for me?" Just half a pound of each and every pound is fine! Any less would be fine! "
Director Xiong waved his hand, "Whatever you want to change, I'll get you some later!" These are must-have condiments in restaurants! "
Director Xiong continued: "Based on 1,240 kilograms and 2.7 yuan per kilogram, the total is 3,348 yuan! "Zhang Haoyu stuffed the money and certificates into his schoolbag, actually putting them into the space warehouse.
Director Xiong found some fresh ginger, about half a catty, as well as four garlic heads, eight small onions, two green onions, six small chives, and four or five coriander heads.
“Not much stock! You take it back and use it first, and I’ll get some for you when the goods are delivered tomorrow! Zhang Haoyu said quickly: "Director Xiong, that's enough, that's enough!" "
Zhang Haoyu put his things into his schoolbag and left the state-owned hotel. He planted things into the ground with his thoughts and poured water from the spiritual spring! When I came to the supply and marketing cooperative, there were not many people buying things at this time, just a few.
The people at the supply and marketing cooperative are very happy today, they must have finished dividing the meat. Seeing Zhang Haoyu come in, everyone greeted him warmly!
Zhang Haoyu also responded with a smile. "Xiaoyu! Come, come with me to the office for a cup of tea. Zhang Haoyu followed Director Tang to the office of the supply and marketing cooperative. Director Tang enthusiastically said, "Xiaoyu, sit down and I'll make tea for you!" "
After the two sat down, Zhang Haoyu took out a pack of Chinese cigarettes, handed one to Director Tang, and lit one himself. "Xiaoyu, wild boar meat is priced at 3 yuan per pound for you, what do you want to change? "
Zhang Haoyu thought for a while, "I want two flashlights and some batteries! As for the others, we need Zhonghua Tobacco, Maotai Liquor, and Erguotou. Highly bulk Erguotou is also fine! "
Director Tang said: "The flashlight and batteries are fine. There is not much Chinese cigarettes and Moutai left, but there are several hundred kilograms of bulk Erguotou in the warehouse!" Xiaoyu, you rest for a while, I'll get something. "
After a while, Director Tang happily entered the office with two flashlights and a box, "Xiaoyu, two flashlights, 12 batteries, the Chinese cigarettes are gone, only two are given every time, and they are bought at once!" "
"I still have 6 bottles of Moutai. Do you think I can give you 150 kilograms of Erguotou in bulk, 6 bottles of Moutai, plus a flashlight and batteries?" "
"Okay, Uncle Tang! Then let's go get the bar! I used a tricycle to deliver it to the hunters, but they were still waiting! "
After leaving the office, Director Tang shouted: "Xiao Zhu, put those bottles of Maotai liquor on the tricycle, then push the tricycle to the door of the backyard warehouse and load 150 kilograms of Erguotou in bulk! "
Director Tang asked Shang Xiaosha to come with him to help. Zhang Haoyu and Tang also went to the warehouse together. Zhang Haoyu saw two blue and white porcelain water tanks. Director Tang asked: "Xiaoyu, do you like those two tanks?" "
"Um! It looks so good! "Then I'll give you those two vats, which can hold two hundred kilograms of wine! But if I give you those two vats, I can only give you 4 bottles of Maotai!"
"Okay, Uncle Tang, I want those two tanks!" Several people carried the two tanks of wine to the tricycle. Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujin tied the wine tanks with ropes.
Zhang Haoyu pushed the tricycle and left the supply and marketing cooperative, found an alley and put two cylinders of wine and four bottles of Maotai into the space warehouse. He circled back to the supply and marketing cooperative, holding a pheasant and a hare in his hands.
Zhang Haoyu handed the pheasant and hare to Director Tang, "Uncle Tang, this pheasant and hare is for you, take it back and try it!" Director Tang took the pheasant and smiled, "Then I'm welcome!"
